title: Replace contact flare with Paper pulsing border
context: Start with Paper's configurable shader to preserve fidelity and support later field-focus interactions and article shaders.

tasks.title: Integrate a responsive, accessible contact shader
acceptance_criteria: The contact flare is replaced by Paper Pulsing Border using the supplied visual settings; canvas dimensions adapt to the form.
The decorative effect does not intercept input or obscure contact content, and responsive gutters remain intact.
Shader code loads only near the contact section; animation stops offscreen and when the document is hidden.
Reduced motion, unavailable WebGL, and JavaScript disabled retain a static decoration and usable form.
Settings are isolated for later interaction work; npm run verify and independent evaluation pass.

tasks.title: Adjust contact padding and border offsets
acceptance_criteria: Contact form padding is 2.5rem 2rem below 30rem and 2.5rem 3.5rem at 30rem and above.
Border offsets are top -33%, right -36%, bottom -30%, left -25%.

tasks.title: Pulse contact border on field focus
acceptance_criteria: Each input or textarea focus eases smoke from 0.49 to 0.78 and speed from 0.46 to 1.1 over 300ms, returning over another 300ms.
Rapid focus changes restart smoothly without overlapping animation loops; initial focus during shader loading triggers once ready.
Reduced motion and unavailable WebGL retain static fallback; animation resources are cleaned up.
npm run verify and independent evaluation pass.
